content.title: Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival
content.text: If you are using a screen reader and are having problems using this website, please call (888) 226-0076 for assistance. Please note, this number is for accessibility issues and is not a ticketing hotline. PARKING INFO & TIPS FOR EVERYONE Arrive early to avoid delays. Park where instructed by parking personnel. ATTENDEES WILL BE DIRECTED IN REAL TIME AS TRAFFIC CONDITIONS MAY FLUCTUATE. Remember where you park by taking a pic of the lot number sign or drop a pin! Pay attention to the color path you use to walk from parking to venue. No tailgating allowed. No camping or sleeping in your car. No RV, trailer or golf cart parking. Separate, Accessible Parking lot available (See Accessibility / ADA) Parking & Directions maps will be posted closer to festival dates. Address / Getting Here Empire Polo Club 81-800 Avenue 51 Indio, CA 92201 Follow directions below and on festival maps (posted closer to festival dates). Follow signs and obey all traffic laws & personnel. Not following instructions may send you driving in circles due to road closures, no left turns, etc. Traffic routes are subject to change. DAY PARKING INFO & DIRECTIONS Hours Friday-Sunday 11am-2am Info Day parking is not guaranteed, as per capacity restrictions. Cars left after 2am will be towed. Everyone in the vehicle must be wearing a Festival Wristband. No pick-ups or drop-offs in Day Parking (use Pick Up & Drop Off location). Motorcycles may park in ADA lot. Directions From All Directions, approach Empire Polo Club. Follow signs and traffic personnel. PRO-TIP: fill your car with 4+ friends and decorate it for CARPOOLCHELLA ® - and you could win prizes like VIP for life. Learn More Preferred Parking Info Hours Friday-Sunday 11am-2am Info Access the Preferred Parking Lot via Ave 49/Monroe St. Do not use Hjorth St. Park and enter the Venue through the north entrance. No vehicle ins & outs. No pick-ups or drop-offs (use Pick Up & Drop Off location). Vehicles parked must fit within the 8.5’ x 16’ spot. Purchase of a preferred parking pass is required (valid Fri-Sun). No entry allowed after 10pm. Cars left after 2am will be towed. Everyone in the vehicle must be wearing a Festival Wristband. Visit passes page to purchase. Directions From 10 Eastbound: Exit at Monroe St. and travel south. Right at Ave 49. Left into Lot 1 on left. ⚠ Don’t attempt to approach north on Monroe. COMPANION CAMPING PARKING & READY-SET TENT PARKING (LOT 2A) Hours: Thursday 9am - Monday 9am Companion Camping Parking Info: One (1) overnight parking space for an additional vehicle of campers. This is not a camping spot. Parking space valid Thu-Mon. Limit one (1) per order. A very limited amount of Camping Companion Parking Passes are available. If you don’t get one, you’ll have to transport your whole crew and their camping gear in one vehicle. Located adjacent to the campgrounds, but may not be near your campsite. All vehicles will be thoroughly searched. Everyone in the vehicle must be wearing Festival Wristband. No camping or sleeping in your car. Check-in Thu 9am-2am; Fri-Sun 9am-8pm. No ins/outs. No exit during lockdown hours Fri-Sun 9pm-2am. If you need to leave Camping Companion Parking prior to 2am on any night, you must do so before 9pm. All hours are subject to change based on safety concerns and traffic conditions. If you drive out, you will forfeit your spot. PRO-TIP: Pack your heavy supplies in the vehicle that will be parked in your Car Camping site. Save your strength on the walk from Car Companion Camping. Companion Camping Parking & Ready-Set Tent Parking Directions: From 10 Eastbound Exit at Jefferson St., continue to Indio Blvd. Right at Jefferson St. Left at Ave 50. Left at Madison and immediate right into Lot 2A. ⓘ All friend & family pick up & drop off, rideshare and taxi drop-offs are here on Thursday. PREMIUM CAMPING PARKING (LA CAMPANA / LAKE ELDORADO) (LOT 4A) Hours:Thu 9am–Mon 9am.Directions: From 10 Eastbound Exit at Jefferson St., continue to Indio Blvd. Right at Jefferson St. Left at Ave 50. Right at Madison St. Follow signs to Premium Camping Parking: Lake Eldorado / La Campana on left. CAR CAMPING / GROUP CAR CAMPING / POWERED CAR CAMPING / PREFERRED & PREFERRED FRONT ROW CAR CAMPING / TOLLBOOTHS (LOT 13A OR 2A* Thursday only) Hours: Thursday 9am – Monday 9am Directions: From 10 Eastbound Exit at Jefferson St., continue to Indio Blvd. Right at Jefferson St. Follow signs and traffic personnel to check-in lanes. Car campers will be directed in real time to either the North or *South tollbooths *Thursday only, until 3pm. No Thursday drop-offs. Must use Lot 2A. *Subject to change, check back closer to festival dates for most updated info. Biking Bike access is available at the following intersections: Avenue 50 & Madison (Red Path) Avenue 52 & Madison (Green Path) Avenue 49 & Monroe (Yellow Path) Avenue 52 & Monroe (Blue Path) NO Bike access on: South side of Ave 49 North side of Ave 52 West side of Monroe East side of Madison Bike Details Bikes should stay on the colored paths. Bikes locked to anything other than racks will be removed and forfeited. Lights and reflectors are required by law when biking at night. Motorized scooters (Bird, Lime, Jump, etc.) are prohibited at Coachella. Bike Rack Details Camping Lot 8 on 801 North Street right near the ADA Box booth. Near the Shuttle Lobby on the Yellow path, north side of Ave 50. Check parking map for bike icons. Subject to change Walking Pedestrian access is available at the following intersections: Avenue 50 & Madison (Red Path) Avenue 52 & Madison (Green Path) Avenue 49 & Monroe (Yellow Path) Avenue 52 & Monroe (Blue Path) ⚠️ Absolutely no pedestrians will be allowed on Monroe (btwn. Ave 49 and Ave 52) or Madison (btwn. Ave 50 and Ave 52). Public Transit Greyhound Bus (National Bus Service) Indio Station 83-100 Indio Blvd Indio, CA 92201 (760) 347-5888 Sunline Transit Agency (800) 347-8628 Amtrak Multiple stations and bus stops in the Indio/Palm Desert area. Airports Bus & Train Greyhound Bus (National Bus Service) Indio Station 83-100 Indio Blvd Indio, CA 92201 (760) 347-5888 Sunline Transit Agency (Local Bus) (800) 347-8628 Amtrak (Train) Multiple stations and bus stops in the Indio/Palm Desert area. Fast-Charging Stations Level 2 Charging Stations Black Car / Limo Drop Off We operate an on-site Drop-Off area for licensed black car and limo services (Pass Required). Drop-offs and staging are allowed Fri-Sun 12pm-10pm. Staging for pickups is allowed until 11pm. Post 11pm there will be in-bound road closures and are likely to encounter delays. Car services wishing to utilize this area must apply for a pass using this form. This includes limousines, party buses, SUVs, rogue or non-sanctioned shuttles and all other vehicles making multiple trips to pick up and drop off patrons. No commercial vehicles will be given access to the Black Car/Limo Pass 1A Drop Off area without a valid pass. No commercial vehicles will be given access to the Preferred Parking Lot, or any other vehicle parking area. Any vehicles without this pass must use the public pick up/drop off area at the corner of Madison St. & Ave. 52. Passes are for drivers to service pre-booked clients only. Absolutely no solicitation of rides will be allowed on the festival footprint. 2026 Pricing $3,500 for limos 10 seats (including driver) or less $5,000 for shuttles Over 10 seats (including driver) or shuttle-style/bus-type NOT longer than 35' Apply Here
